{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "vasild",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected that nLockTime defeats privacy, restart loses delayed transactions, and transactions can be linked without private broadcast; supported using nLockTime for broadcast timing"
    },
    {
      "login": "ismaelsadeeq",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "questioned whether clients should handle delays instead and asked for concrete privacy gains"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:6017308339",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Wallet transactions setting nLockTime to current block height defeat the privacy benefit of delayed broadcast",
      "quote": "Putting the current block height in `nLockTime` when the transaction is created defeats delaying its broadcast",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed and plans to rework the feature to use nLockTime for scheduling",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6018323325",
        "c:6315555722"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6315555722",
      "status_by_quote": "@vasild , thanks for this and previous feedback! I also arrived at the same conclusion, see the previous comment."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6017308339",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Delayed broadcast does not prevent transactions from being linked to the same node if send-to-all broadcast is used",
      "quote": "If send-to-all broadcast is used, then the otherwise unrelated transactions can be linked as coming from the same node.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author clarified delayed broadcast is only supported with private broadcast",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6018323325"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6018323325",
      "status_by_quote": "delayed broadcast is available only in conjunction with private broadcast."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6017308339",
      "part": 3,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Unbroadcast delayed transactions are lost if the node restarts",
      "quote": "The delay does not play nice with node restart (unbroadcast transactions would be lost).",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed queue persistence is important but suggested it for a followup",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6018323325"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6018323325",
      "status_by_quote": "Persisting the queue is an important feature, should be added (but I thing a followup is fine)."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6017308339",
      "part": 4,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Questioned the description text regarding undo/cancel support",
      "quote": "Hmm?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained it was an error in description and removed it",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6018323325"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6018323325",
      "status_by_quote": "Undo/Cancel support: that's a mistake in the description, removed"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6032279563",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Consider having clients perform the broadcast delay themselves rather than adding delayed broadcast logic to the node",
      "quote": "the delay itself seems like something a client can already do: sleep for a random time, then call sendrawtransaction on a node running with -privatebroadcast.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained that client wallets are rarely always-on, making core a better place to handle delayed broadcasts",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6084992932"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6084992932",
      "status_by_quote": "That's true, most client could do the delay themselves ... However, many clients can not do this easily, as wallets are "
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6032279563",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "What is the concrete privacy gain and the harm in an attacker knowing the transaction creation time?",
      "quote": "What is the concrete privacy gain? What's the actual harm in an attacker knowing the creation time?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author provided concrete scenarios including breaking timing correlation with external events and scheduling transfers",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6084992932"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6084992932",
      "status_by_quote": "Transactions related to specific events could be probabilistically matched based on timing analysis. To avoid that, the "
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "vasild reiterated that nLockTime defeats delayed broadcast privacy and supported using nLockTime to decide when to send. optout21 concurred and announced plans to rework the PR to base scheduling on nLockTime and drop random delay.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "reworking the PR to use nLockTime for scheduling and dropping random delay computation",
      "id": "c:6315408546"
    }
  ]
}
